info.title: 3alraf Mobile API
info.description:
JSON API for the Flutter apps.

Host: one shop on APP_URL. GET /api/v1/app-config returns the app switches plus `store` {name, country, currency{code,symbol}, default_locale, locales[{code,rtl}], timezone, base_url}; GET /api/v1/store returns the full shop profile. The `X-Tenant` header of old app builds and old `{slug}.` hosts are ignored (the API answers on legacy hosts too; generated URLs always use APP_URL). GET /api/v1/tenants is DEPRECATED: a one-item list in the old shape (slug, name, country, flag, currency, default_locale, locales, languages, logo_url, base_url) for old app builds.
Envelope: every response is {success, message, data, meta}; errors are {success:false, message, errors?, data:null, meta:{}} with 401/403/404/422/429.
Auth: Sanctum bearer tokens of two kinds. Customer tokens (ability `customer`, from /auth/login or /auth/register) and affiliate tokens (ability `affiliate`, from /affiliate/login) are not interchangeable.
Guests: send the `X-Cart-Token` returned by the first cart call; after login call POST /cart/merge (or send it with /auth/login) to merge it.
Checkout: place the order, then follow meta.next_action: redirect_to_payment (open meta.payment_url, then poll GET /payments/return/{token} until meta.paid), upload_proof (re-upload of a rejected wallet transfer proof, POST /orders/{token}/proof), retry_payment (POST /orders/{token}/pay), none (COD). Orders always wait for the store admin to confirm.
Offline payment: a wallet / bank-transfer payment method (or the wallet prepay leg of COD) REQUIRES the transfer proof file as the multipart field `proof` (jpg, png, webp or pdf) on POST /checkout and POST /checkout/validate; 422 `proof` when missing, invalid or already used for another order; 429 + Retry-After when the anti-abuse limiter trips. Bundles: add with POST /cart/items {bundle_id, quantity}; special packaging: GET /checkout/packaging then send packaging_option_id.
Money values are decimal strings in the store currency. Cost, profit and commission fields are never exposed.

get.summary: PNG QR (logo, high error correction) of the affiliate's product link; `?variant=ID` for one variant. Send the bearer token
App switches (min/latest version, store URLs, maintenance) and the shop basics `store` (name, country, currency, locales, timezone, base_url). Optional ?version=x.y.z

put.summary: PUT auth/me: profile + in-app password change (send `password`, `password_confirmation` and `current_password`; name and email are required)

delete.summary: DELETE auth/me {password} (or {confirm:true} for Google-only accounts): anonymises the account, revokes every token. Irreversible

get.summary: GET blog?per_page=&page= (newest first; list items carry no `content`)
Brand page header (name/logo/product count); its products: GET catalog?brand={slug}
Live fixed-price bundles whose components are all purchasable (add one with POST cart/items {bundle_id, quantity})

post.summary: After login: merges the guest cart (X-Cart-Token) into the customer's cart
Totals for the current selections (city / shipping / payment / code optional)

get.summary: Category / brand / tag page or search: ?category=slug &brand=slug &tag=slug &q= &brands[]= &values[]= &price_min= &price_max= &sort= &per_page= &page=
Filter sidebar data for the same scope (brands, attribute values, price range, sort keys)
Category page header (name/image/description/breadcrumbs/children); its products: GET catalog?category={slug}
Active special-packaging options (price only; cost is never exposed). Send the chosen id as `packaging_option_id` on cart/quote and checkout

post.summary: Full quote with the strict checkout rules (stock, discount, shipping, COD prepay); 422 with field errors when something is wrong

get.summary: Active custom landing pages (slug + title + web URL)
One custom page by slug + its product grid (pinned products first, then the page filters). Query: price_min, price_max, sort, page

delete.summary: DELETE devices {token}: call on logout / push opt-out. Idempotent

post.summary: Customer cancellation with a structured reason code (feature `return_intel`; 404 when off)

get.summary: GET orders/{token}/invoice: the invoice as a PDF download (same document as the web page)

post.summary: New gateway link for an unpaid online order

get.summary: GET orders/{token}/proof: the uploaded transfer proof (private disk, 404 when none). Upload is POST on the same path

post.summary: Wallet transfer proof (stays on the private disk; the admin approves it, which is what confirms the payment)

get.summary: Call after the in-app browser comes back from the gateway. Non-authoritative: only the signed webhook marks an order paid, so poll this until `paid` is true

post.summary: Only for delivered purchases; one review per product (edits go back to pending moderation)

get.summary: Tag page header; its products: GET catalog?tag={slug}
DEPRECATED (old app builds): the single shop as a one-item list in the old store-picker shape. Response header `Deprecation: true`

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: ar | en (limited to the store locales)

XCartToken.name: X-Cart-Token
XCartToken.description: Guest cart token, returned in the X-Cart-Token response header

XAffiliateRef.name: X-Affiliate-Ref
XAffiliateRef.description: Affiliate ref (uuid) of a shared link, for commission attribution

XAttribution.name: X-Attribution
XAttribution.description: Growth first-touch attribution: base64url(JSON) of {utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, ref, link, gift_session, ab}, max 1024 chars. Stored on the cart (first touch wins) and copied to the order channel at checkout. Malformed values are ignored.
